# TechFNM

> TechFNM is a digital marketing agency in Karachi, Pakistan offering SEO services, web development, mobile app development, social media marketing, ecommerce and content writing for businesses in Pakistan and worldwide.

## About Us
TechFNM is a digital agency based in Karachi, Pakistan. We provide high-quality software development and digital marketing services to help businesses grow online. Founder & CEO: Muhammad Naeem.

## Services
- [SEO Services](https://techfnm.com/services/seo-services): technical SEO, keyword research, on-page and local SEO, link building
- [Digital Marketing](https://techfnm.com/services/digital-marketing): paid ads (Google & Meta), campaign strategy
- [Web Development](https://techfnm.com/services/web-development): custom, fast, mobile-responsive websites
- [App Development](https://techfnm.com/services/app-development): mobile and web applications
- [Ecommerce](https://techfnm.com/services/ecommerce): online stores with secure payments
- [Social Media](https://techfnm.com/services/social-media): social media management and growth
- [Content Writing](https://techfnm.com/services/content-writing): SEO-friendly copy and articles
